title: Fix Fill Slider Knob And Hover
description: Puzzle 3d fill-count slider (ready extent + loading ring) does not show the knob and lacks the regular hover effects (row background fill change, emphasis on knob, range, tree guide lines). Root cause: loading ring is applied on the whole WindowMeasureTreeRow with z-index:1 ::after, covering the thumb and obscuring hover chrome. Move loading onto the slider track wrap (sibling of thumb), pass loading into Slider, keep row hover/guide emphasis intact.
summary: Fill-count slider loading ring no longer covers the knob or hover chrome. Loading is applied on a track-only wrap (sibling of the thumb) via Slider.loading; WindowMeasureTreeLeaf no longer receives loading for sliders, so row hover fill, knob/range emphasis, and tree guide emphasis work while planning still shows the ring on the track.
